tools.name: zana_connect
tools.title: Connect your Zana domain
tools.description: Create a private sign-in link to connect your own Zana domain to your Slack identity. Use when the user asks to connect or change their Zana connection. Accepts their my-domain address or its label; omit it to choose an owned computer after sign-in. Does not grant access or run a job: account ownership and approval on that computer are required. Share the returned link only with this user.

domain.description: Your own Zana domain, for example my-domain.zana-ide.com

tools.name: zana_list_projects
tools.title: List available Zana Projects
tools.description: List registered Projects on your linked computer, whether imported, and their approved Slack destinations. No filesystem paths or credentials. To import an unconnected Project use zana_import_project only at the user’s request.

tools.name: zana_import_project
tools.title: Import a Project into Slack
tools.description: Import one exact Project ID from zana_list_projects at the user’s explicit request. Creates a private Project channel using locally saved defaults and adds only the linked user and bot. Requires imports from Slack to be enabled in Zana. Repeating the same import reuses the existing channel. Does not launch a job. Check zana_list_projects for the resulting destination if the response is interrupted.

tools.name: zana_launch_options
tools.title: List available harnesses and models
tools.description: List available harness IDs and the Project default profile on its configured machine. Supply an exact harness ID to retrieve its available models. Read-only; does not launch work or change defaults. Use before a user-requested harness/model override.

channel_id.description: Optional connected destination to resolve a Project with several profiles

harness.description: Optional exact available harness ID to list models for

tools.name: zana_launch_job
tools.title: Launch a Zana job
tools.description: Start an agent task on your linked computer using an approved Project and channel from zana_list_projects. This posts the task in that channel and uses its saved profile unless the user requests a harness/model override. Discover exact available IDs with zana_launch_options; never guess model IDs. Per-task overrides do not change Project defaults. Only call when the user requests work. Generate a unique request_id for each new task; reuse it unchanged on retries. Returns acceptance, not completion. Never retry an unconfirmed launch with a new request_id; check zana_job_status.

task.description: Task the user wants the agent to perform

request_id.description: Unique idempotency key; reuse for retries of this same task.

harness.description: Optional exact harness ID from zana_launch_options. Supply model too when changing harness.

model.description: Optional exact available model ID for the chosen harness, from zana_launch_options.

tools.name: zana_job_status
tools.title: Check a Zana job
tools.description: Check the job_id returned by zana_launch_job. Returns queue/agent state, its Slack conversation, and only the latest confirmed shared answer. Permission prompts remain in Zana. An uncertain launch must be inspected before requesting another.

tools.name: zana_list_capabilities
tools.title: List enabled plugin capabilities
tools.description: Discover the locally enabled read-only capabilities contributed by installed Zana plugins, including their input schema. Never assume an installed plugin is enabled for Slack.

tools.name: zana_run_capability
tools.title: Use an enabled plugin capability
tools.description: Call an explicitly enabled read-only plugin capability from zana_list_capabilities. Use its exact capability ID and a JSON object matching its input_schema. The linked user must enable it locally. No arbitrary plugin RPC or tool access.

arguments_json.description: JSON object matching the capability input_schema

commands.description: Choose an imported Project and start an agent
Prepare a job in an imported Project
List available Projects or import one by exact name or ID
Start work or continue a Project conversation

features.title: Browse Projects
features.description: List registered Project names and approved Slack destinations. Launching and importing also require this to be enabled.

features.title: Import Projects
features.description: Create or reuse a private channel for a requested Project, using your saved import defaults.

features.title: Start new jobs
features.description: Start agents from Slackbot, /zana or a new @Zana conversation. Turning this off also blocks jobs still waiting to start.

features.title: Continue conversations
features.description: Send follow-up tasks to existing Zana threads from Slack. Running work continues when this is turned off.

features.title: View job progress
features.description: Show job state, activity updates and task previews in Slack. Basic stop and mute controls stay available.

features.title: Share answers
features.description: Allow new answers in Slack and answer previews. Agent summaries also follow each channel’s sharing setting. Previously posted Slack messages remain visible.

features.title: Use plugin tools
features.description: Discover and call the read-only plugin tools you individually enable below.
